scope: Actual SPARQL execution. No LLM-only comparison performed.

participants.query: PREFIX ex: <urn:repronim:cnp:expanded:> PREFIX nidm: <http://purl.org/nidash/nidm#> PREFIX prov: <http://www.w3.org/ns/prov#> SELECT (COUNT(?p) AS ?n) WHERE { ?p a prov:Person }

barratt_source_lineage.query: PREFIX ex: <urn:repronim:cnp:expanded:> PREFIX nidm: <http://purl.org/nidash/nidm#> PREFIX prov: <http://www.w3.org/ns/prov#> SELECT ?output ?source ?activity WHERE { VALUES ?output { <urn:repronim:cnp:expanded:derived/parcel1/sub-10159> } ?output prov:wasGeneratedBy ?activity; prov:wasDerivedFrom ?source . ?activity prov:used ?source }

claims_addressing_transfer.query: PREFIX ex: <urn:repronim:cnp:expanded:> PREFIX nidm: <http://purl.org/nidash/nidm#> PREFIX prov: <http://www.w3.org/ns/prov#> SELECT ?claim ?scope WHERE { ?claim ex:addresses ex:Q2; ex:scope ?scope }

counterevidence_on_transfer.query: PREFIX ex: <urn:repronim:cnp:expanded:> PREFIX nidm: <http://purl.org/nidash/nidm#> PREFIX prov: <http://www.w3.org/ns/prov#> SELECT ?claim WHERE { ?claim ex:qualifies ex:Q2 }

phenotype_columns.query: PREFIX ex: <urn:repronim:cnp:expanded:> PREFIX nidm: <http://purl.org/nidash/nidm#> PREFIX prov: <http://www.w3.org/ns/prov#> SELECT (COUNT(?v) AS ?n) WHERE { ?v a nidm:DataElement }
